title: How to track Google Alerts in Slack, Trello, or almost any app
summary: Google Alerts make it easy to keep up with headlines on any subject, but there's one big downside: headlines are delivered via email. What if you'd rather keep up to date without keeping your inbox open? Turns out you can. Here's how to get an RSS feed for any Google Alert, and how to use that RSS feed to send Google Alerts to Slack, SMS, a Google Sheet, or basically any app you can imagine.
